claims.claim: Ideal Topstar manual sewing machine available for sale.
claims.evidence: Witness report shows a vintage sewing machine with front panel text reading “IDEAL TOPSTAR” and a foot pedal/power cord present.
Witness report does not show any “Made in Japan” marking or country-of-origin text in the visible photos.
Witness report only describes visible condition and presence of power/cord/pedal; no test-run sound/video or performance result is shown.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual are included.
claims.evidence: Witness report says no clear view of needle area and whether accessories/attachments are included; no manual is shown.

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: Witness report shows dust/age marks and light wear but provides no service history documentation or internal inspection.

risks.risk: Whether it actually stitches correctly (thread tension, needle timing, feed). Photos cannot confirm mechanical performance.
risks.proof: A short video of a full test run sewing straight and turning corners (showing thread tension and even stitches) with the needle area clearly visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used machine with unknown working condition (assume may need adjustment/repair).

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete accessories (bobbin(s), bobbin winder, attachments, spare needles) and whether the pedal is functional.
risks.proof: A laid-out photo/video showing every included accessory and the manual, plus a close-up of the pedal and its connection while powered.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown accessories (assume missing common parts and/or manual).

risks.risk: Electrical safety and pedal/motor condition (cord/pedal wiring integrity not inspected).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the power cord ends and pedal wiring/strain relief, plus a video showing the machine powering on and speed responding to the pedal.
risks.if_unproven: Price as electrical condition unknown (assume may have cord/pedal issues).

risks.risk: Wear or damage to needle area and internal parts (presser foot, feed dogs, bobbin case/inner parts).
risks.proof: Clear close-up shots of the needle plate area, presser foot, feed dogs, and bobbin case/inner compartment (open where applicable).
risks.if_unproven: Price as cosmetically aged with potential internal wear (assume may require cleaning/parts).

risks.risk: Exact model variant and completeness of controls (knobs/dials/reverse/lever functions not verified).
risks.proof: Video showing each control/lever/dial being operated while powered (speed changes, any reverse/lever actions) with the panel readable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controls unverified (assume some functions may not work).

proof_requests: Send a video test run sewing on fabric (straight stitch and a corner) with the needle area visible.
Show a complete inventory photo/video of all accessories included (bobbin(s), bobbin winder, attachments) and the original manual.
Provide close-up photos of the power cord ends and pedal, including any visible markings and strain relief.
Show close-ups of the needle plate area, presser foot, feed dogs, and bobbin case/inner compartment.
Record a short powered video demonstrating speed control and any other levers/knobs on the panel.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item as an IDEAL TOPSTAR vintage sewing machine with pedal/power present, so it can be priced at its worst-case used condition. However, key performance and completeness details are not shown, so the price should assume unknown working order and possible missing accessories/manual.
